## :wrench: Installation
### :one: <b>First installation way</b>

- Open terminal

- Clone this repository

    ```
    git clone https://github.com/13atm01/SDDM-Theme.git
    ```

- Change directory to the SDDM Theme

    ```
    cd SDDM-Theme
    ```

 - Change to the directory you want to install, for eg:

    ```
    cd "Wuthering Waves"
    ```
    ```
    cd "Mornye"
    ```
    
 - Setup the new SDDM Theme

    ```
    sudo ./install.sh
    ```
 
 - If you want to test/see the theme preview

    ```sh
    sddm-greeter --test-mode --theme /usr/share/themes/Mornye  #Replace “Mornye” with the version you installed
    ```
    
 - Restart your SDDM

    ```sh
    sudo systemctl restart sddm    #Make sure to save all your work before run this command!
    ```
 - Reboot your PC
